label: B25-BOARD-RUNNER-REMOTE-SEAL
title: Correct, AST-validate and hash-seal the reusable board runner bundle on GamePC
triggered_by: T-034 preserved an incompatible first bootstrap before root creation; its corrected local bundle also needs a fail-closed preflight gate before remote seal.
scope: Copy the exact corrected T-034 local bundle into a T-035 task-owned ignored root, make only the reviewed compatibility and preflight fail-closed corrections, generate a new content-addressed manifest, then validate the exact resulting bytes in a fresh GamePC root using only file-based PowerShell AST/hash tools. No hardware or process query is permitted.

required_corrections.bootstrap: Use a PowerShell-version-compatible parent derivation (`[System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($root)` preferred, or the already corrected supported -Path parameter set). Never copy the failed remote bootstrap artifact.
required_corrections.preflight_gate: In run_board_once.sh, if preflight.ps1 returns nonzero, record BLOCKED_PREFLIGHT_NO_HARDWARE and exit before candidate label, marker, owned server, programmer, terminal or golden path. Static control-flow evidence is required.
required_corrections.no_other_semantic_delta: All other reusable bundle behavior remains identical unless a concrete audit finding is documented and separately diff-reviewed in evidence.

acceptance.copy_provenance: Every source file hash is checked against T-034 evidence before copy; record the exact two reviewed diffs and final per-file hashes.
acceptance.local: bash -n, Python py_compile, manifest JSON, no-hardcoded-consumer audit, no-inline-PowerShell audit and single candidate/golden/terminal control-flow audit pass.
acceptance.freshness: New remote root/bootstrap absent; no deletion or overwrite. Upload the corrected bootstrap once and invoke only with pwsh -File.
acceptance.remote_ast: Upload the sealed bundle once. `pwsh -File validate_scripts.ps1` reports zero parse errors for all PowerShell files.
acceptance.remote_seal: `pwsh -File verify_seal.ps1` reports all bundle bytes/SHA equal to the T-035 manifest; fetched AST/seal outputs are hash-bound.
acceptance.boundary: Remote actions are only filesystem, AST parse and SHA. jtagconfig/quartus_pgm/nios2-terminal/jtagserver/process enumeration and every FPGA/JTAG/reset/power/Flash action remain zero.
acceptance.consumer: Handoff gives the exact bundle directory/manifest/hash to copy byte-for-byte into the next board task. No script may be edited after this seal.

resource: All GamePC filesystem/parser actions hold resource-lock gamepc in one validation window; no EDA heavy job.
forbidden_regions: hardware/JTAG/process enumeration, quartus_pgm, nios2-terminal, server start/stop, FPGA configuration
JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset, power or process termination
inline PowerShell -Command/stdin, remote replacement after first upload or validation retry
hardcoded consumer task/root or any programmer path reachable after failed preflight

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.passed: fresh remote root/bootstrap, compatible root creation, one bundle upload, local syntax/static/control-flow checks
result.blocker: remote validate_scripts.ps1 returned Argument types do not match before producing parse results; verify_seal was not run
result.next: new fresh no-hardware task with typed parser refs and ordinary PowerShell arrays
